retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome collage featuring dual portraits anchored by a central vertical chain and iced-out jewelry with a gritty, smoke-filled atmosphere.
triggerTerms: gritty black and white hip hop cover
urban portrait with smoke and grain

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, monochromatic composition featuring two male portraits flanking a central vertical axis defined by heavy diamond-encrusted chains. The background is a dense, textured mix of smoke and film grain, with a taped-on label effect for the title text.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two large-scale portraits
Vertical dominance of the central jewelry element
High contrast between bright metallic highlights and deep black shadows
Textured overlay of grain and smoke unifying the collage
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and smoke textures
Central vertical alignment of jewelry elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large portraits occupy the left and right thirds of the frame, slightly overlapping the central vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, diamond-encrusted pendant and chain running vertically through the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central pendant, move upward to the taped title, then outward to the two faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured, filled with dark smoke and grain rather than empty space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal grays for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for highlights on jewelry and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin textures and smoke.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between metallic glints and dark voids.

letterConstructionRules: High tracking (letter spacing) for the title

composition.overlap: Placed on a semi-transparent tape strip

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Small serif display text paired with a standard advisory block at the bottom.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman or similar Serif
candidateDirections.reason: Provides a classic, editorial contrast to the gritty urban imagery.
High contrast strokes match the sharp highlights of the jewelry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white collage of two urban male portraits with a central vertical diamond chain, surrounded by thick smoke and heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a semi-transparent horizontal tape strip at the top center. Place two lines of white, high-tracked serif text in uppercase on the tape. Add a standard parental advisory logo at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is there a central vertical chain element?
Is the text placed on a tape-like graphic?
Is the grain and smoke texture prominent?

mustRedesign: Modern sans-serif bold fonts for the main title
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast highlights on jewelry
Ensure the tape strip looks like a separate physical layer
Verify the grain is uniform across the entire composition
Confirm the text is legible despite the small scale
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine dual high-contrast portraits with a central vertical metallic anchor, unified by a heavy monochromatic grain and smoke overlay, topped with small-scale serif typography on a tape-strip graphic.
